prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a small house in a town built on terraces inside a volcanic crater. Dark red clay tile roof. Heavy dark basalt stone walls with red-orange accents and iron fittings. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 176 x 160 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: EDIT THE USER-ATTACHED LAYOUT GUIDE into ONE standalone pixel-art JRPG building sprite. Treat attached guide as strict pixel-perfect geometric mask and positional template, not an aesthetic reference. Output same canvas dimensions and aspect ratio 1232 x 1120 (corresponding to 176 x 160 art pixels at 7x nearest-neighbor scaling). Transparent alpha background everywhere currently magenta: do NOT render magenta or any background. Preserve the house outer silhouette with roof rectangle x=14..1219, y=196..714, and wall rectangle x=56..1176,y=715..1119, roof-to-wall seam exactly at y=715. Preserve the strong horizontal seam across roof at y=423..436. The guide's window apertures x=238..350 and x=868..980, y=896..1037 must remain precisely in place and size; preserve center dark brown WALK-THROUGH DOOR x=539..693 y=896..1119 (touches bottom of image), exactly where and how large it is. Crucial: don't reposition, resize, or occlude either window or door. Roof viewed from above, wall front viewed straight on, classic 3/4 top-down RPG view, NO perspective converging outlines. Roof has dark red clay tiles, line at y423 is a row boundary or raised dark eave within roof, at y715 is pronounced roof eave. Wall is heavy dark basalt stone, rich charcoal plum and purple-red shadow colors, red-orange mortar/architectural accents, small iron fittings. Windows glow warm amber internally, this is the ONLY luminous element, no projected light. Door a proper unobstructed dark timber door with a small iron handle and iron bands, visually clearly a door that can be walked through. Small basalt chimney may protrude into top transparent margin, minimal ironwork and tile wear can be added but silhouette otherwise unchanged. Carefully hand-placed crisp uniformly sized square pixel clusters, modern premium hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art. Work on exactly 176x160 underlying grid then scale nearest-neighbor 7x: absolutely no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smoothing, no photography, no noise, no dithering/checkerboards. 3-10 art pixel clustered texturing, clear shapes, 4-6 rich earthy hues per material, shadows lean purple-red, highlights warm ochre. Neutral even overcast evening upper-left soft light, clean base colors, no cast shadows, no night darkness, no vignette, no glow spill, no people, no text, no ground.
